  <title>Breathing Systems Recall: Intersurgical Inc. Removes 22mm Smoothbore Breathing Tubes and Systems</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls-and-early-alerts/breathing-systems-recall-intersurgical-inc-removes-22mm-smoothbore-breathing-tubes-and-systems</link>
  <description>Intersurgical removes 22mm Smoothbore breathing tubes and systems because connectors may detach, causing ventilation loss, brain damage, or death.</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 25 Nov 2026 00:00:00 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls-and-early-alerts/breathing-systems-recall-intersurgical-inc-removes-22mm-smoothbore-breathing-tubes-and-systems</guid>
    </item>
